parsed.draft_response:
Hi—thanks for the details, and I’m sorry this is impacting reporting for ~40 enterprise customers after the v2.8 upgrade.

We’ve escalated this to our engineering team for urgent review, since your logs indicate repeated Salesforce auth token refresh errors starting right after the upgrade.

To help us move quickly, could you paste the following from the logs (exact text/error codes) and confirm the scope?
1) The exact auth token refresh error messages (including any error codes) and one or two representative log entries.
2) Where these logs are located (job name/integration name, environment/instance) and the time range (timestamps, and whether it’s all day since the upgrade).
3) Whether **all** Salesforce sync jobs are failing or only certain accounts/objects.
4) Any Salesforce/OAuth-related configuration changes you made during/after the upgrade (credentials, connected app settings, scopes, schedules).

If you can share screenshots/exports of the relevant log lines, that’s perfect.

In the meantime, engineering is already working the escalation path to assess what could have changed with v2.8 and how that relates to token refresh failures. We’ll follow up as soon as we have a targeted next step for you ahead of your renewal call tomorrow.
promised_actions: Escalate the issue to engineering for urgent review.
Ask for specific log details (error text/codes, timestamps, scope) to speed up diagnosis.
Provide an update with a targeted next step once engineering confirms the likely cause.
safety_notes: Avoid claiming a specific root cause or resolution because exact error text, scope, and v2.8 changes are not provided.
Acknowledge escalation without guaranteeing timeline beyond requesting information and stating escalation is underway.
